title: Using only the data from the ‘results’ table, find the three years in which
question: Using only the data from the ‘results’ table, find the three years in which the sum of the highest total points earned by any driver and the highest total points earned by any constructor in that year (both calculated by summing up points from the ‘results’ table) is smallest, and list those three years in order of ascending total.

prediction.sql:
WITH drv AS (
  SELECT r.year, d.driver_id, SUM(d.points) AS pts
  FROM results d
  JOIN races r ON d.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, d.driver_id
),
con AS (
  SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, SUM(c.points) AS pts
  FROM results c
  JOIN races r ON c.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id
),
ydrv AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(pts) AS max_pts
  FROM drv
  GROUP BY year
),
ycon AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(pts) AS max_pts
  FROM con
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT ydrv.year AS year
FROM ydrv
JOIN ycon ON ydrv.year = ycon.year
ORDER BY (ydrv.max_pts + ycon.max_pts) ASC
LIMIT 3

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH drv AS (
  SELECT r.year, d.driver_id, SUM(d.points) AS pts
  FROM results d JOIN races r ON d.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, d.driver_id
),
con AS (
  SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, SUM(c.points) AS pts
  FROM results c JOIN races r ON c.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id
),
ydrv AS (SELECT year, MAX(pts) AS m FROM drv GROUP BY year),
ycon AS (SELECT year, MAX(pts) AS m FROM con GROUP BY year),
tot AS (
  SELECT ydrv.year, ydrv.m + ycon.m AS total
  FROM ydrv JOIN ycon ON ydrv.year = ycon.year
)
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(year, ', ') AS years
FROM (SELECT year FROM tot ORDER BY total ASC LIMIT 3);
